video_title: SHAMS DRIVE BY 💨 Why did the Dallas Mavericks fire Jason Kidd? | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Masai Ujiri's complete restart for the Dallas Mavericks after Jason Kidd's firing
quotes.excerpt: Masai Ujiri comes in and I think for him, it's a complete restart, a clean slate, a fresh start
quotes.quote: Masai Ujiri comes in and I think for him, it's a complete restart, a clean slate, a fresh start for the entire organization. They've already fired Nico Harrison. You now you fire Jason Kidd. Anthony Davis is already gone. You traded him basically for salaries and a few draft picks. You still have Kyrie Irving on this team who you feel like has a future with Cooper Flag. Everything around this organization, that's the one element of the team that's not going to change. It's Cooper Flag. But for them to move off of Jason Kidd right now, Pat, they're eating four years and almost $45 million to get off of Jason Kidd and essentially wash their hands of this situation. And this is all because team leadership wants a clean start.

quotes.speaker: Pat McAfee
quotes.summary_phrase: Dallas Mavericks' new leadership flushing out the Mark Cuban regime
quotes.excerpt: We're going to eliminate the thought... This is Cooper Flag's team.

text_blocks.speaker: Pat McAfee
text_blocks.text: Masai Ujiri came into the building? You, Luka trade, like it, don't like it? I thought we had to do it at time. Sick. All right. You were a part of the Luka trade, right? If I do recall, you were the big name that came in. Yeah. All right. You made the trade, right? Yeah. All right. You're fired first. Okay, I'm going to let you know that right now. You definitely, you're out of here first. This is the dumbest, you see what he's doing over there? He's in shape too. He's older, he's mature, he's what do you think was going to happen? You, you are, every time I look at you, the only reason why you're here is because we traded Luka. So we're going to get you the hell out of here for sure. And I heard you, coach, you were saying you thought it was because of you, not because of Luka, the whole thing. Get your ass out of here as well. That is what this is, right? This is Cooper Flag's team. We are going to eliminate the thought. And Mark Cuban's the owner, that Luka was here, that we traded his ass away. We are going to, this is Cooper Flag, the main event is who we would like to be. Is that what this is from your standpoint?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: I mean, forget anyone involved with just the Luka Doncic trade. We've seen Patrick Dumont, the owner, essentially flush away anyone that was even around the Mark Cuban regime, right? Nico Harrison, Jason Kidd, they were all brought in by Mark Cuban. Luka Doncic, a Mark Cuban guy. The only Mark Cuban guy left on that team right now is Kyrie Irving. Kyrie Irving is a generational player, generational talent. Masai Ujiri did his press conference today and he said we want to see Kyrie Irving and Cooper Flag on the court together.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Internal toxicity and in-fighting plaguing the Dallas Mavericks organization
quotes.excerpt: There's been so much toxicity around that organization that now Masai Ujiri is inheriting.
quotes.quote: There's no question, Jason Kidd, anyone else in that organization, where they were at with the Luka Doncic of it all, maybe that didn't play a factor in people's firings, but certainly from an informational perspective, from a position of like, there's good background context. There's an investigation to an extent that you have to do when you come into an organization. So there's that, there's the in-fighting that's been going on internally there. There's been so much toxicity around that organization that now Masai Ujiri is inheriting.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's high ankle sprain status for Game 2 of the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox, definitely a game-time decision. I'm told he has a high ankle sprain
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox, definitely a game-time decision. I'm told he has a high ankle sprain and that's something he suffered in the Minnesota Timberwolves series. He basically played through it, but it's stiffened up, it's added swelling in the last several days and so he missed Game 1. That was essentially a game-time decision. He ends up missing that game. They're going to take it closer to game time again today, but the team is letting De'Aaron Fox make his decision. He's going to test it out throughout the day, get treatment, be at shootaround that's going on right now and then pre-game test it out. But you win Game 1, so I do wonder internally with the Spurs, yeah, they're probably going to want him to see can he play, but how much consideration do you have to do, how much caution are you going to have given that you just won that Game 1. But this is of course a must-win type of environment for Oklahoma City. I'm very curious to see how Chet Holmgren comes out against Victor Wembanyama on defense. He was a guy that was one of the top three guys in Defensive Player of the Year voting. So Chet Holmgren, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, J-Dub, a lot to prove tonight.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Madison Square Garden's electric atmosphere during the Knicks' playoff game
quotes.excerpt: The way that arena was trembling, I kid you not, it's like an earthquake.
quotes.quote: No injuries on the Oklahoma City side. J-Dub came back in Game 1. He's been full throttle. San Antonio just has the De'Aaron Fox situation. I thought I was going to get injured last night at Madison Square Garden. Literally, the way that arena was trembling, I kid you not, it's like an earthquake. When Jalen Brunson's making those bank-in shots, it's like a four-point game, then it's a two-point game, a three-point game, the building was literally shaking.
